messages.body: Attached is the revised annual pricing: 150 seats for $54,000. Let me know if procurement needs a different breakdown.
The revised $54,000 annual price for 150 seats works, so pricing is complete. Legal is targeting signature by September 30.
Checking what your legal team needs next for the renewal.
Please send the final DPA redline by September 11. We are moving forward with procurement once that language is settled; legal still targets signature September 30.
Let's use next week's planning call to settle renewal scope.
This note is only about APAC pilot logistics, not the enterprise renewal.
Sharing the requested project detail for review.
Thanks, our team will review and reply with any questions.
Following up on timing and the next working session.
